newsitem.title: USA: White House's Raines sees budget deal taking time.
newsitem.headline: White House's Raines sees budget deal taking time.

text.p: White House budget director Frank Raines said Wednesday he thought it would take time for the White House and Congress to achieve a budget agreement.
"I don't think there's going to be any conclusion for quite some time," Raines told reporters after his first meeting with House Budget Committee Chairman John Kasich, Republican from Ohio.
Earlier, Raines met with Sen. Frank Lautenberg of New Jersey, the ranking Democrat on the Senate Budget Committee.
Early this week Raines had expressed the hope that the administration and congressional Republicans would be able to agree on common economic assumptions by February.
He also said he hoped to reach a budget agreement by then.
